My coworker takes credit for my work and it's eating at me
</message>
output: It makes me feel undervalued and frustrated, like I'm constantly second-guessing my own efforts and wondering why I even bother putting in the work if no one notices. I can't help but replay every moment where they stepped in and claimed what I did, and it leaves a bitter taste in my mouth, making me question if I should speak up or just quietly keep doing the job and hope someone else will see the truth.
